film.pick: {label} is the villain of which film or series?
film.odd: Three of these villains come from {value}. Which one does not?
film.reverse: Which of these villains comes from {value}?

rows.label: Michael Myers
rows.description: fictional character in the Halloween franchise
rows.hook: stalks babysitters in a quiet suburb wearing a pale white mask and mechanic's coveralls

rows.label: Hannibal Lecter
rows.description: fictional character created by Thomas Harris
rows.hook: is a brilliant, cultured psychiatrist with a taste for human flesh who advises an FBI trainee

rows.label: Jason Voorhees
rows.description: main character of the Friday the 13th series
rows.hook: wears a hockey mask and haunts the teen counselors of a summer camp by a lake

rows.label: Pennywise
rows.description: main antagonist of Stephen King's novel It
rows.hook: is a shape-shifting clown who lurks in the sewers of a small Maine town and preys on kids' fears

rows.label: Darth Vader
rows.description: fictional character from the Star Wars media franchise
rows.hook: is a black-armored Sith lord famous for his wheezing breath, deep voice and red lightsaber

rows.label: Freddy Krueger
rows.description: the main antagonist of the A Nightmare on Elm Street film series
rows.hook: is a burn-scarred man in a striped sweater with a bladed glove who attacks teens in their dreams

rows.label: Sauron
rows.description: fictional character from J.R.R. Tolkien's legendarium
rows.hook: is an all-seeing flaming eye atop a dark tower, hungry for a golden band of power

rows.label: Bane
rows.description: fictional character in the DC Comics universe, a supervillain
rows.hook: is a hulking masked brute who famously breaks the Caped Crusader's back

rows.label: Lord Voldemort
rows.description: main antagonist of J. K. Rowling's Harry Potter series
rows.hook: is a noseless dark wizard who left a boy with a lightning-bolt scar and a house of horcruxes

rows.label: Magneto
rows.description: fictional character in Marvel Comics
rows.hook: controls metal with his mind and leads mutants against humankind

rows.label: Anton Chigurh
rows.description: fictional hitman
rows.hook: is a coin-flipping hitman with a bowl haircut and a cattle stunner

rows.label: Xenomorph
rows.description: fictional extraterrestrial species from the Alien film series
rows.hook: is a sleek, acid-blooded creature with an elongated head and a second set of jaws

rows.label: HAL 9000
rows.description: fictional character in Arthur C. Clarke's Space Odyssey series
rows.hook: is a calm-voiced shipboard computer with a glowing red eye that won't open the pod bay doors

rows.label: Palpatine
rows.description: fictional character from Star Wars
rows.hook: is a hooded Sith emperor who unleashes blue lightning from his fingertips

rows.label: Keyser Söze
rows.description: character in the 1995 film The Usual Suspects
rows.hook: is a near-mythical crime boss whose true identity is the big mystery

rows.label: Lex Luthor
rows.description: fictional character in DC Comics
rows.hook: is a brilliant bald billionaire and arch-enemy of the Man of Steel

rows.label: Norman Bates
rows.description: fictional character
rows.hook: is a shy motel owner with an unhealthy devotion to his mother

rows.label: Nurse Ratched
rows.film: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
rows.description: main antagonist of Ken Kesey's 1962 novel One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
rows.hook: is a stern head of a psychiatric ward who rules her patients with an iron hand

rows.label: Thanos
rows.description: fictional character from the Marvel Cinematic Universe
rows.hook: is a giant purple Titan who gathers six stones to wipe out half of all life with a snap

rows.label: Cruella de Vil
rows.description: fictional character in Dodie Smith's "The Hundred and One Dalmatians" and in the Disney animated film and franchise "101 Dalmatians"
rows.hook: is a fur-obsessed socialite with black-and-white hair who wants a coat made of spotted pups

rows.label: Green Goblin
rows.description: name used by numerous fictional characters in Marvel Comics
rows.hook: is a glider-riding, pumpkin-bomb-throwing villain in a ghoulish mask

rows.label: Davy Jones
rows.description: fictional character from Pirates of the Caribbean
rows.hook: is a tentacle-bearded ship captain who commands a ghostly vessel and hides his heart in a chest

rows.label: Hans Landa
rows.description: fictional Inglourious Basterds character

rows.label: T-1000
rows.description: robotic antagonist in the film "Terminator 2: Judgment Day"
rows.hook: is a shape-shifting liquid-metal android sent from the future to hunt a boy

rows.label: Captain Hook
rows.description: fictional pirate
rows.hook: is a swashbuckling pirate with a metal claw for a hand who is chased by a ticking crocodile

rows.label: Wicked Witch of the West
rows.description: fictional character and the most significant antagonist in L. Frank Baum's children's book The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
rows.hook: is a green-skinned, broom-flying sorceress who sends winged monkeys after a girl and her dog

rows.label: Agent Smith
rows.description: Fictional character appearing in The Matrix
rows.hook: is a sunglasses-wearing sentient program in a dark suit who can copy himself endlessly

rows.label: Maleficent
rows.description: Disney fairy character
rows.hook: is a horned dark fairy who curses a baby princess to prick her finger on a spinning wheel

rows.label: Scar
rows.description: fictional character and main antagonist from The Lion King
rows.hook: is a jealous uncle with a black mane who schemes with hyenas to seize the throne

rows.label: Annie Wilkes
rows.description: fictional character in the 1987 novel Misery
rows.hook: is a former nurse who holds her favorite novelist captive after rescuing him from a snowy crash

rows.label: Dr. Evil
rows.description: character in Austin Powers films
rows.hook: is a bald, cat-stroking mastermind who demands one million dollars with his pinky at his mouth
